- Internal metadata updated.
- No user-facing changes.

Initial release of phpmyadmin-manager

- Manage phpMyAdmin as a Docker container for local MySQL database access.
- Provides a web UI at http://localhost:8081 for database management.
- Includes commands for start, stop, and status via CLI script.
- Requires mysql-manager and proxy-manager to be running first.
- No data persistence—stateless phpMyAdmin container.
